plugin.name: merge_reporter
plugin.author: Rhuli
plugin.purpose: Reports Chaos Portal merge contents and successful merges
plugin.description:
Merge Reporter
Automatically captures the area names shown by the Chaos Portal merge test.
When this line appears: To merge these chaos portals, use "cast 'merge chaos' confirm"
The plugin says the complete list of area names.
When the merge succeeds: You merge the chaos of N portals into a single blank chaos portal.
The plugin says how many Chaos Portals were successfully merged.

trigger.name: merge_reporter_start
trigger.match: ^Testing merge of the following Chaos Portals into a blank:$

trigger.name: merge_reporter_confirm
trigger.match: ^To merge these chaos portals, use "cast 'merge chaos' confirm"$

trigger.name: merge_reporter_success
trigger.match: ^You merge the chaos of (?<count>\d+) portals into a single blank chaos portal\.$

muclient.script:
local mergeAreas = {}
local function clearMergeAreas() mergeAreas = {} end
function mergeReporterStart(name, line, wildcards) clearMergeAreas() end
function mergeReporterAddArea(name, line, wildcards) local area = wildcards.area or "" local ptype = wildcards.ptype or "normal"
area = area:gsub("^%s+", "") area = area:gsub("%s+$", "")
if area ~= "" then
-- Every area explicitly starts with our purple color. local formattedArea = "@x105" .. area
-- Mark Golden portals, then restore purple afterward. if ptype == "Golden" then formattedArea = formattedArea .. " @W(@YG@W)@x105" end
table.insert(mergeAreas, formattedArea) end end
function mergeReporterConfirm(name, line, wildcards) if #mergeAreas == 0 then clearMergeAreas() return end
local areaList = table.concat( mergeAreas, "@W, " )
SendNoEcho( "say @x105Merge Reporter@W :: " .. "@x099Merging the following portals@W: " .. areaList .. "@w" )
clearMergeAreas() end
function mergeReporterSuccess(name, line, wildcards) local count = tonumber(wildcards.count) or 0
SendNoEcho( "say @x105Merge Reporter@W :: " .. "@x099Successfully merged@W " .. "@x105" .. count .. "@W Chaos Portal" .. (count == 1 and "" or "s") .. "@W into a single blank portal.@w" )
clearMergeAreas() end
function OnPluginInstall() clearMergeAreas() end
function OnPluginClose() clearMergeAreas() end
